title: FI-Lab in older ICU patients: derivation and multi-database external validation (analysis code)
description: Analysis code for a study of a laboratory-based frailty index (FI-Lab) in adults aged 65 years or older admitted to an intensive care unit. FI-Lab is a 30-item Rockwood deficit-accumulation index built only from laboratory tests drawn on the first ICU day. The index is derived in MIMIC-IV and transported with frozen coefficients to two independent databases (NWICU and eICU-CRD), with discrimination, calibration slope, calibration-in-the-large and observed-to-expected ratios reported for each. The repository contains the PostgreSQL extraction and statistical pipeline (cohort construction, FI-Lab computation, outcome ascertainment, sequential severity adjustment, frozen-coefficient external validation, calibration and decision-curve analysis, and database audits) together with identifier-free aggregate result tables and the final figures. Patient-level data are not included: MIMIC-IV, eICU-CRD and NWICU are available from PhysioNet to credentialed users under their respective data use agreements.
